details: Bitcoin fell to approximately $63,200-$63,400 on July 28, marking an eleven-day low, with the broader crypto market experiencing a slide. This decline is attributed to investor caution ahead of the Federal Reserve's rate decision and a selloff in Asian tech stocks. US spot Bitcoin ETFs also recorded net outflows, indicating weakened institutional demand.
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $63K Amid Fed Hike Fears & ETF Outflows

details: The US Senate has postponed a vote on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, a key crypto market structure bill, to prioritize a Russia sanctions package. This delay pushes any potential vote towards the August 8 recess, prolonging uncertainty regarding cryptocurrency regulation and the oversight framework for digital assets. The bill's passage in 2026 is now estimated at 33-37%.
title: US Senate Delays Vote on CLARITY Act, Extending Crypto Regulatory Uncertainty

details: Ethereum has demonstrated strong performance, outperforming Bitcoin with a 19.6% gain over the past month. Spot Ethereum ETFs have attracted significant inflows, outperforming Bitcoin funds in recent weeks and on July 27. The ETH/BTC ratio reached a three-month high, coupled with continued institutional and whale accumulation, and a record 34% of ETH supply now staked.
title: Ethereum Outperforms Bitcoin with Strong ETF Inflows and Whale Accumulation
